description: This source file defines the 'DetailedMenuItem' class within the 'OrangeHRM' project, specifically in the 'Menu' namespace. It encapsulates the structure and behavior related to detailed menu items, including properties like ID, title, module, screen, and child menu items. It provides methods for creating instances from 'MenuItem' entities, adding child items, and retrieving properties relevant to menu display and hierarchy.

classes.name: DetailedMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a detailed menu item with properties such as ID, title, module, screen, and child menu items. It includes methods for creating an instance from a MenuItem object, managing child menu items, and retrieving property values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this menu item.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module associated with this menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen URL or identifier associated with this menu item.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen URL or identifier for this menu item.

methods.name: createFromMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a DetailedMenuItem instance from a MenuItem entity, extracting properties like ID, title, module, and screen.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child DetailedMenuItem to this menu item.

methods.name: getChildMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of child menu items.
